title: Spring Launches a Block Up a Ramp
body: A spring with $$k=200\, \tfrac{\text{N}}{\text{m}}$$ is compressed by $$0.7\, \text{m}$$ and used to launch a $$2\, \text{kg}$$ block up a frictionless ramp. Use $$g=9.8\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}}$$.
lesson: 8. Potential Energy and Conservation of Energy
